fuse.name: E_DLOAD_DISABLE
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. Disable the removable SD and then USB downloader in Apps PBL error handler, as well as the method to force download during code boot via magic cookies in IMEM.

fuse.name: ENUM_TIMEOUT
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. BOOT ROM must support USB enumeration timeout. Timeout applies to both enumeration for FLCB (fast low current boot) and USB download mode. If USB is not enumerated within time (90 seconds), quit USB enumeration If USB suspend or disconnected after enumeration, start timer again.

fuse.name: FORCE_DLOAD_DISABLE
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. To disable method to force boot from USB via GPIO or magic number in RAM.

fuse.name: FORCE_USB_BOOT_GPIO_DISABLE
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. To disable method to force boot from USB via GPIO or magic number in RAM.

fuse.name: SDCC_ADMA_DISABLE
fuse.description: 0 is default ADMA mode enabled _x000D_ 1 - ADMA mode disabled.

fuse.name: FAST_BOOT
fuse.description: These fuses are used by boot code to specify which device has priority to be booted from. For SDM855, the mapping is as follows: 00000: Default (UFS HS G1 -> SD -> USB3.0 -> EDL (eDL path- USB only)) 00001: SD -> UFS HS G1 -> eDL (eDL path USB only) 00010: SD -> eDL (eDL path- USB only) 00011: USB -> eDL (eDL path- SD then USB) 00100: QSPI -> eDL (eDL path- SD then USB) 00101: SPI-> eDL (eDL path- SD then USB) 01000: UFS 1-LANE PWM G4 -> SD -> USB3.0 -> EDL (eDL path- USB only).

fuse.name: PBL_QSPI_BOOT_EDL_ENABLED
fuse.description: When fuse is blown, EDL Path will be QSPI->SD->USB else the EDL path will be as before SD->USB.

fuse.name: SPI_CLK_BOOT_FREQ
fuse.description: Default is 37.5 MHz and when blown 19.2 MHz.

fuse.name: SW_FUSE_PROG_DISABLE
fuse.description: This fuse disables the ability to write fuses through the software interface.

fuse.name: PBL_FDL_TIMEOUT_RESET_FEATURE_ENABLE
fuse.description: Fuse bit to reset device if PBL enters into EDL mode unintentionally.

fuse.name: WDOG_EN
fuse.description: Combined with GPIO Wdog disable (connects to MPM). Prevents the Watch Dog from being disabled by the GPIO.

fuse.name: PBL_LOG_DISABLE
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. Control logging mechanism in Boot ROM (If blown, Logging is disabled & mandated for external parts).

fuse.name: PBL_USB_TYPE_C_DISABLE
fuse.description: 0: QMP PHY receives CC_OUT (0 SS Lane1 or 1 SS Lane2) 1: QMP PHY receives 0 due to PORT SELECT MUX s default value 0 selects SS Lane1.

fuse.name: ROOT_CERT_TOTAL_NUM
fuse.description: Defines the total root cert number supported from the certificate (Upto 4 roots).

fuse.name: QSPI_DMA_DISABLE
fuse.description: 0 => QSPI DMA is enabled 1 => QSPI DMA is disabled.

fuse.name: USB_SS_DISABLE
fuse.description: Used to disable USB SS enumeration during Boot.

fuse.name: SP_DISABLE
fuse.description: Disables Secure Processor. There is also a QC equivalent fuse.

fuse.name: DEBUG_POLICY_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to not provide --fuse-debug-policy-disable. Debug Policy is bypassed when this bit is 1. Debug Policy provides a means to re-enable debug capabilities under OEM-specified selectable conditions.

fuse.name: PBL_FDL_TIMEOUT_RESET_TO_VAL
fuse.description: This fuse allows OEMs to have configurable timeout values for FDL timeout reset feature Fuse value | Timeout value (msec) 00\t => 5 (default) 01\t => 30 10\t => 60 11\t => 120.

fuse.name: SP_NVM_AR_CONFIG
fuse.description: Recommended value is --fuse-sp-nvm-ar-config=0x0. NVM configuration for SP-ARI _x000D_ 00: Not configured._x000D_ 01: Capacitor not populated._x000D_ 10: Capacitor populated._x000D_ 11: Reserved.

fuse.name: SP_FIPS_ENABLE
fuse.description: ENABLE FIPS mode for SPU. Disable by Default and blow to enable.

fuse.name: TZ_SW_CRYPTO_FIPS_ENABLE
fuse.description: Enable FIPS mode for TZ software crypto. Disable by default and blow to enable.

fuse.name: MODEM_CRYPTO_FIPS_ENABLE
fuse.description: Enable FIPS mode for modem. Disable by default and blow to enable.

fuse.name: SP_FIPS_OVERRIDE
fuse.description: Override SP_FIPS_ENABLE fuse. Non-override by default and blow to override the SP_FIPS_ENABLE fuse to disable the FIPS feature in SPU.

fuse.name: TZ_SW_CRYPTO_FIPS_OVERRIDE
fuse.description: Override TZ_SW_CRYPTO_FIPS_ENABLE fuse. Non-override by default and blow to override the TZ_SW_CRYPTO_FIPS_ENABLE fuse to disable the FIPS feature in TZ.

fuse.name: SPU_IAR_ENABLED
fuse.description: Enable Android StrongBox Insider Attacker Resistance (IAR) mechanism in SPU. Fuse is then mirrored in SPU.

fuse.name: SPARE_REG0_SECURE
fuse.description: This fuse determines if the corresponding OEM spare region is treated as secure. If blown, it indicates secure, and the region has the properties of a customer private key, and is not readable through SW while debug is enabled.

fuse.name: SPARE_REG1_SECURE
fuse.description: This fuse determines if the corresponding OEM spare region is treated as secure. If blown, it indicates secure, and the region has the properties of a customer private key, and is not readable through SW while debug is enabled.

If blown, it indicates secure, and the region has the properties of a customer private key, and is not readable through SW while debug is enabled._x000D_ * This region is reserved for DOLBY and will be blown by QC.

fuse.name: SP_ARI_TEST_MODE_FEATURE_ENABLE
fuse.description: SPU ARI Test Mode is a special feature to assist in development, testing and manufacturing of devices that uses SPU and ARI. In ARI Test Mode, SPU places a limit on the number of fuses ARI uses but SPU NVM is fully functional. If the fuse usage limit is reached, SPU NVM will continue to function but replay protection will not be provided. If this feature is enabled, OEMs must turn off Test Mode using a software API, for any shipping device. This fuse enables this feature.

fuse.name: SP_ARI_SUSPENSION_FEATURE_ENABLE
fuse.description: SPU ARI Suspension allows the temporary suspension of ARI, so no further fuses will be consumed beyond the next Power on Reset (PoR). This fuse enables this feature.

fuse.name: EKU_ENFORCEMENT_EN
fuse.description: When this fuse is blown will enable enforcement of the EKU field in the certificate.

fuse.name: DISABLE_RSA
fuse.description: When this bit is 0 and signed image type is SHA384 + RSA/ECC is 0 => RSA OPERATION_x000D_ When this bit is 0 and signed image type is SHA384 + RSA/ECC IS 1=> ECC OPERATION USING PKA IP_x000D_ When this bit is 1 and signed image type is SHA384 + RSA/ECC is 0 => Error_x000D_ When this bit is 1 and signed image type is SHA384 + RSA/ECC IS 1=> ECC OPERATION USING PKA IP.
